note: Authored questions for the quantitative finance corpus (arXiv q-fin). Every answer_contains string was tested against the indexed corpus before being written: each appears verbatim in between one and forty passages. Strings that matched too widely were rejected rather than kept and caveated -- 'Sharpe' alone matched 176 passages across 14 documents, 'liquidity' 163, and 'ARCH' 581 because it is a substring of 'research' and 'architecture'. That last one is the same trap the ML set hit with 'NSP' and 'span'.
